title: Dimensions for 70-, 65- and 35-mm Motion-Picture Film Splices
scope: 1.1 This practice specifies the significant dimensions of splices for 70- , 65-, and 35-mm motionpict ure f ilm int ended for projection and exhibition or for laboratory printing. 1.2 There are a number of methods for splicing triacetate or polyester motion-picture film that have found practical and commercial acceptance and that meet the operational requirements for the physical strength of the bond.
